hand_verified_reasoning: Per category-rules.md, ICs default to exact-MPN tier 0 only, unless the engineer explicitly opens it up -- here specified_mpn is null, signalling the requirement is parametric only. The candidate is a pin-compatible op-amp (same 8-pin SOIC footprint, supply range 2.7-6V covers the required 2.7-5.5V) from a different manufacturer. 'Pin-compatible parts from different manufacturers are tier 2 at best' because electrical characteristics, internal protection, and errata differ across manufacturers even when headline parameters match -- so this passes, but is capped at tier 2 and requires engineer review before it can enter a plan.
